decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
The window(s) in the flank elevations of the proposed development shall be of purpose-made obscure glass and shall thereafter be retained in that form.&nbsp;

<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;tab-stops:49.65pt">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town
and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or
any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be
installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without
the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: cuckoohilldrive-46 / 0 – existing ground<div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 1 REV E – PROPOSED ground&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 2 REV E – existing first&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 3 REV C – PROPOSED first&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 4 REV C PROPOSED second&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 5 – existing elevations&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 6 REV E – PROPOSED elevation</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 6A REV – E PROPOSED elevations</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 7 REV E – existing roof plan&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 8 REV E – PROPOSED BLOCK PLAN</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 9 REV C – PROPOSED roof plan</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 10 REV E – PROPOSED SITE PLAN SECTION&nbsp;</div><div>cuckoohilldrive-46 / 11 – EXISTING SITE PLAN SECTION&nbsp;</div><div>Location Plans, Cover Letter, Form 4 Reasonable Exceptions Statement, CIL, FLOOD RISK ASSESSMENT</div>

<p>Landscaping and screening</p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Notwithstanding the approved details, prior to the use of the patio hereby approved, a scheme of soft landscape works adjacent to the boundary with no 48 Cuckoo Hill Drive (in between the patio and the boundary) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, including the following:&nbsp;</p><p>1. Proposed planting plans at a scale of not less than 1:100.&nbsp;</p><p>2. Schedule of proposed plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes, proposed numbers and densities, all at the time of proposed planting.&nbsp;</p><p>3. A landscape implementation programme.&nbsp;</p><p>All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species.&nbsp;</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>In addition, a scaled elevation&nbsp; plan illustrating the appearance of the 1.8m boundary screening panel/s at the edge of the patio adjacent to no 48 Cuckoo Hill Drive shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority.&nbsp;</p><p>The approved screening panel/s shall be erected before the use of the patio commences and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>
description: Front porch, single and two storey side to rear extension, single storey rear extension, first floor front extension.  Alterations and extension to roof to form side dormer and rear dormer with Juliette Balcony.   Roof light in both side roof slopes.  Raised patio to rear with balustrade.   1.8 metre fence to rear.  External alterations. (Demolition of attached garage and front entrance canopy).
